The '''bolt-thrower''' was a mechanical [[Crossbow/Legends|Crossbow]] used by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] infiltration units. It was constructed from spring [[Steel/Legends|steel]], spun graphite, and utilized a fluffed [[Shadowsilk/Legends|shadowsilk]] bowstring to produce a weapon that was near silent, but with the piercing and stopping power of a [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]]. Despite stopping power, the bolt-thrower had the significant disadvantage of only being able to fire one bolt at a time before a timely reloading sequence.
